verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator offers a QR-code-based transfer/export mechanism for moving codes between devices, but this is a proprietary re-import format tied to the app itself, not an open, portable data format usable outside the ecosystem. Community evidence explicitly contradicts any 'open export' claim: users report Google 'makes it stupendously difficult to just get a simple text export to a file' and that the app 'does not allow you to include your codes in your backup, even when encrypted.' missing for 10: no documented open-format (e.g. plaintext/CSV/JSON) export, no independent confirmation of a true 'leave the platform' data portability path.
